title: festuca myuros var. broteroi
intro: Festuca myuros var. broteroi, commonly known as Rough Fescue, is a plant species within the grass family, Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in alleviating various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Rough Fescue include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating bronchitis, asthma, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
